notes: Move around the city freely: fly with WASD or the arrow keys (double-tap for speed, Space/C up and down), Shift + mouse to look around, and a smooth street view at ground level. No fog. Hold a building for a second to drag it, undo/redo every edit, pause and speed up the simulation. The city AI can now edit buildings and knows real places ("make the buildings around this station pink"). Facility colours, see-through agents, a settings window and a cleaner Settings dialog.
